title: Animated character resource?
author: interneth3ro
selftext: So I'm making a factory automation game, heavily story based. I've been using a really bad animated sprite for the main character, and Codex and ChatGPT have been unable to really come up with anything better. Usual problems of repeated frames, or 8 feet and 3 arms, etc. It's top down 2.5D high def, and I just want a usable animated sprite with walking and idle frames. I've tried Pixellab, but it's low res pixel art, I'm looking for something a bit more substantial. Just wondering if anyone has any suggestions or references. Thanks, fam!

comments.author: SquareWolfGames
comments.body: What model are you using in codex? at least chatgpt 6.1 sol is needed in my oppinion. Also how big is your character in width+height? Ive only been generating not too big sizes so maybe that would explain why I have better success.

replies.author: interneth3ro
replies.body: I primarily use 6.1 Sol Medium in Codex, but I haven't thought to try a different model. And I'm not looking for big models or even super detailed. Just... better than what I have, lol. I'll toy around Astra this week, see if it can do any better.

replies.author: SquareWolfGames
replies.body: Oh ok, will you give status updates? Id like to see your progress, I also made an automation game recently with 3 different AI agents.

replies.author: interneth3ro
replies.body: If I can remember to, lol! I'll try. I'm still super early in development, barely any mechanics really in place right now.

comments.author: Project_Asura
comments.body: Have codex generate you a concept art then include it with your prompt into Claude and you should be good to go. Opus 5.5 is way better at sprites than Claude

comments.author: Guildbound
comments.body: Spritecook makes really heavy detailed art, I’ve heard people use video to spritesheets pipeline

comments.author: 314t
comments.body: Might be worth rendering an animated 3D character out to sprites instead. More setup, but at least the legs should stay attached between frames lol
